author: Good Enough
description:
He risked his life during the Gold Rush, and it led to something even bigger.

During the Klondike Gold Rush, Clarence Berry pushed through dangerous conditions and extreme hardship in search of gold. After finally striking it rich, he didn’t stop there, he went on to build a successful oil business, turning one risky decision into a lasting fortune.

This Short tells the story of how risking everything for gold led to even greater success.
